newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tulloch in mine deal with Mt Kersey.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tulloch in mine deal with Mt Kersey.

text.p: Unlisted Tulloch Resources NL said on Thursday it has reached an agreement with Mount Kersey Mining NL, paving the way for a potential A$3.5 million gold and base metals exploration programme at Tulloch's Mulgabbbie project in Western Australia.

"Existing aerial magnetic surveys have identified 11 key geological sites around the Mulgabbie Dome, which have until now, only undergone very limited on the ground exploration," Tulloch's managing director, John Heugh, said in a statement.
Tulloch said Mulgabbie Dome is one of 12 mine projects the company is explorating on the state's eastern goldfields, either independently or through joint ventures.
Tulloch has said it plans to list on the Australian Stock Exchange during the first half of 1997.
